replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Regenerative blocks in YML 

For example: An Iron block gets broken. After the set amount of time in YML it reappears in the same spot.

Now, here's the thing. The blocks should have an option to avoid entities or not. So if you tunnel and the whole landmass is regenerative then depending on whether the blocks avoid enitities or not they will either let the tunneler be or suffocate the tunneler.

It can be arranged like so:
everywhere:
    type: global
    flags:
      build:
         who: '*'
         allow: true
         triggers:
            regenerate:
                 time: 10 (Seconds) !-Time taken to respawn-!
                 avoid-entity: true !-Avoid entities, when off, it will suffocate entities-!
                 sound: true !-The sound of the block--!
                 switch: Stone !-Switch places with another block. Can be used to make a more naturally themed map-!
                 blocks:
                    0: iron

Villager Trading
This is a very awesome feature that really needs to be added. Would spice up maps exponentially.

    type: point
    spawn: 0.5,0,0.5,90,0
    flags:
      interact:
         who: 'red'
         allow: true
         triggers:
            modify-trade:
                 mob: villager !-You can choose any mob-!
                 multitrade: true !-Whether multiple people can trade with the same villager-!
                 immortal: true !-Whether the mob can be killed or not-!
                 trade:
                    0:
                       trade: emerald !-item needed to give to villager-!
                       trade: nether_star !-Sometimes there can be two trades with a villager-!
                       item: diamond_sword !-Item given to you when you exchange the ones above-!
                       enchants:
                       - damage_all:1
 
item-keep, armor-keep and inventory-keep       
You've worked for the amount of stuff needed to get the trade from the store then suddenly you are killed by a stray arrow and a teammate picks up your stuff. Boy does that make you angry and want to exit the game!

Well no more! With these, you get to keep what you've secured on the battlefield or bought from a trade.
  
       item-keep:    
       - iron_spade
       
       armor-keep:
       - iron_helmet
       
       inventory-keep !-Keeps all the items stored in your inventory-!

Maximum build height


       max-height
       - 50
                    
Thoughts anyone?
